title: Curious Calligraphy Cuttlefish
statement: A small, lantern-eyed cuttlefish that ripples looping, handwriting-like patterns across its skin whenever a visitor lingers at the glass, as if answering a question you hadn't quite asked aloud. It drifts through a warm, amber-lit kelp grove strewn with frosted sea glass, and quietly arranges the pebbles into tidy spirals when it thinks no one is watching.
